title: FIFA Statutes 2024 edition (official PDF)
locator: Art. 10 (Admission, suspension and expulsion); Art. 11 (Admission, incl. 11.2); Art. 22 (Confederations), paragraph (g). PDF pages as printed in the document's own contents (Art. 10-11 at printed p.14, Art. 22 at printed p.22). Text extracted from the official PDF's text layer and verified against the saved file.
supported_statement: Official FIFA Statutes 2024: Art. 10 - 'The Congress shall decide whether to admit, suspend or expel a member association solely upon the recommendation of the Council.' Art. 11.2 - 'Membership is only permitted if an association is currently a member of a confederation.' Art. 22(g) - a confederation may, upon the recommendation of FIFA, grant an association applying for membership 'the status of a provisional member', which 'shall grant associations the right to take part in the confederation's competitions and conferences', with other rights and obligations regulated by the confederation's own statutes; the sentence 'Provisional members may not take ...' continues in the PDF (text extraction truncated it; the saved PDF is authoritative).
limitations: Current (2024) edition; the statutes in force in 1979/1991/1992/1994 were not obtained, so this document evidences the institutional structure (Congress decides admission; provisional membership is a confederation-level status short of FIFA membership) rather than the historical rule text. Used together with the official member-count record for the policy determination (see policy_provisional_membership.md).
